shared_elements: repeated small units arranged in rows/registers (in B, glyph blocks; in A, repeated animal legs and figures)
justification: A depicts a narrative figural scene: a bearded archer and companion in a spoked-wheel chariot drawn by horses, trampling a fallen figure, all in profile within a horizontal panel; B shows only a vertical column of squarish, rounded sign-blocks arranged in paired rows, with no recognisable figures, animals or vehicles. The only correspondence is that both are shallow relief carvings with repeated units, which is far too generic to indicate any shared iconographic tradition.
